title: Requires the Department of Land Conservation and Development to study the public use of lands and submit findings to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly related to land use no later than September 15, 2026.
headline: SB 259 did not pass

claims.text: SB 259 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
